` [Highlight start] Neither Liquid IV nor Pedialyte cures a hangover [Highlight end] ` or speeds up how fast your body clears alcohol, though both can help ease dehydration-related symptoms like thirst, fatigue, and mild headaches. ### Key Differences

- **Format & Convenience:** Liquid IV comes in single-serve powder packets that you mix into water, making it easy to pack while traveling. Pedialyte is widely sold as a ready-to-drink liquid (and in powder/freeze-pop forms), so you don't need to mix it when you feel rough.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1xf6xScj3b85JpCOc5fKNMj3g-a9HOkKIcL3B0bXpGZ56ivLKAq87ilfkYTfj2-MCmg2lFyh9HMkrzbOzzST2kUXb9scaSv-9BTz9hbW_xpoZ-PMYsyaqi6OYpGVP4BN6KDjxrGNJy_-FtgE1BRLMeZ7xDdhUAMMblbLgSm7V7PrjEgMyA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF15RgYNrdJT-C8iBkxXAZSjCzURmPaRmopJ6xaYO2lSY1Wd4FIoVHPuDjjbKIDiGBALqa3k8zbt9ab-lTlsFbqfIqjq0hBQjGeEWZ1PXncXCmmcJXymMNgfVnVExgW8EBXvFCIPGmzXpFfEuNVqbCzB56MYnYAOFt3L0yONL9mer6Q_A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXnwGm6ZJs9TvilJIoR-ZLNZwvbEK496Xi7QssLobmO1ty4ZpJa4EfrWDSg5NYAzvoeyaBptVpc5BZ-Nw6Kx21N-0u_InXl0-Fca2indmBPIwgJNikp6ua2dKN4dRcDmqLrxhSvSMurE5Ubg)
- **Formulation & Taste:** Pedialyte is an over-the-counter oral rehydration solution containing water, dextrose, zinc, and electrolytes (sodium, chloride, potassium). Liquid IV is a flavored electrolyte drink mix with a stronger, sweeter/more intense taste.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF15RgYNrdJT-C8iBkxXAZSjCzURmPaRmopJ6xaYO2lSY1Wd4FIoVHPuDjjbKIDiGBALqa3k8zbt9ab-lTlsFbqfIqjq0hBQjGeEWZ1PXncXCmmcJXymMNgfVnVExgW8EBXvFCIPGmzXpFfEuNVqbCzB56MYnYAOFt3L0yONL9mer6Q_A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXnwGm6ZJs9TvilJIoR-ZLNZwvbEK496Xi7QssLobmO1ty4ZpJa4EfrWDSg5NYAzvoeyaBptVpc5BZ-Nw6Kx21N-0u_InXl0-Fca2indmBPIwgJNikp6ua2dKN4dRcDmqLrxhSvSMurE5Ubg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1xf6xScj3b85JpCOc5fKNMj3g-a9HOkKIcL3B0bXpGZ56ivLKAq87ilfkYTfj2-MCmg2lFyh9HMkrzbOzzST2kUXb9scaSv-9BTz9hbW_xpoZ-PMYsyaqi6OYpGVP4BN6KDjxrGNJy_-FtgE1BRLMeZ7xDdhUAMMblbLgSm7V7PrjEgMyA)

### How to Use Them Safely

- **Sip slowly:** Take small sips rather than chugging if your stomach is queasy. Drinking from a cup without a straw can also help limit extra air in your stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXYvQ_7Rl-TFhrPPZjiQtFT0y7HzRWQawfZR-EBHf8GysGwJrjeag_XVoNpnc7GM2OMo58vOvcizASG1umANfSqpAgkpoiwAHgr9xPXNbhC_Vnw_EQosvtpUAaxEPrRFk1_QACRx3rfP0cVgJM7Bg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXkrjouhQI8fVwVRBIb-u4VhJauMU7CypkyBFQGFw15yiWKWoYagYW0c1pgC3M0emqMdEVU4YqPhP2foIah27BHMTRWEWlOQF9rfd1pPwqwluqO6NGHxlmEInXXByM83XJpid8MUGm)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXB5u7cxlI4u7aSLmdFKzdjjsIRI5Y_rkbeRZV5xnpLv1hd528MuKSdp7J_1NCLoSO0I1eW_vm5i_OW2uNoHq0b-DYjLxIolxEwS-64SLrOcbQ_seX54Ee0YNu_ufLxtILTdVI1AwRCg)
- **Pair with food and rest:** Eat bland foods (like broth, crackers, or bananas) as tolerated and sleep to help your body recover.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF1_fHxblJZHoLZGNqfr68ZMmXE_vm0DEzG9iYB6LDnberWTO0oJmqKBkwUdNbQMkHiWMZpYjV5LV3mYRHevOkIV4fwewilW-BI90YvVmbQ98iGtUNzwWcr1cHaPM5tBUuknpMY5JdvWFVfklLo75zLEcS_thk3agYiww9JthQqBMz-dbrihvwXx8JxSsLNlUvLnlHYY5HVQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXkrjouhQI8fVwVRBIb-u4VhJauMU7CypkyBFQGFw15yiWKWoYagYW0c1pgC3M0emqMdEVU4YqPhP2foIah27BHMTRWEWlOQF9rfd1pPwqwluqO6NGHxlmEInXXByM83XJpid8MUGm)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXB5u7cxlI4u7aSLmdFKzdjjsIRI5Y_rkbeRZV5xnpLv1hd528MuKSdp7J_1NCLoSO0I1eW_vm5i_OW2uNoHq0b-DYjLxIolxEwS-64SLrOcbQ_seX54Ee0YNu_ufLxtILTdVI1AwRCg)
- **Check labels and medications:** Watch sugar, sodium, and ingredients if you have health conditions or take medications. Avoid acetaminophen if you've had heavy alcohol intake due to liver strain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF1_fHxblJZHoLZGNqfr68ZMmXE_vm0DEzG9iYB6LDnberWTO0oJmqKBkwUdNbQMkHiWMZpYjV5LV3mYRHevOkIV4fwewilW-BI90YvVmbQ98iGtUNzwWcr1cHaPM5tBUuknpMY5JdvWFVfklLo75zLEcS_thk3agYiww9JthQqBMz-dbrihvwXx8JxSsLNlUvLnlHYY5HVQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXYvQ_7Rl-TFhrPPZjiQtFT0y7HzRWQawfZR-EBHf8GysGwJrjeag_XVoNpnc7GM2OMo58vOvcizASG1umANfSqpAgkpoiwAHgr9xPXNbhC_Vnw_EQosvtpUAaxEPrRFk1_QACRx3rfP0cVgJM7Bg)
- **Watch for emergencies:** Seek immediate medical care if someone shows signs of alcohol poisoning, such as trouble waking, slow or irregular breathing, confusion, seizures, or repeated vomiting.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXYvQ_7Rl-TFhrPPZjiQtFT0y7HzRWQawfZR-EBHf8GysGwJrjeag_XVoNpnc7GM2OMo58vOvcizASG1umANfSqpAgkpoiwAHgr9xPXNbhC_Vnw_EQosvtpUAaxEPrRFk1_QACRx3rfP0cVgJM7Bg)

Avoid acetaminophen if you've had heavy alcohol intake due to liver strain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF1_fHxblJZHoLZGNqfr68ZMmXE_vm0DEzG9iYB6LDnberWTO0oJmqKBkwUdNbQMkHiWMZpYjV5LV3mYRHevOkIV4fwewilW-BI90YvVmbQ98iGtUNzwWcr1cHaPM5tBUuknpMY5JdvWFVfklLo75zLEcS_thk3agYiww9JthQqBMz-dbrihvwXx8JxSsLNlUvLnlHYY5HVQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXYvQ_7Rl-TFhrPPZjiQtFT0y7HzRWQawfZR-EBHf8GysGwJrjeag_XVoNpnc7GM2OMo58vOvcizASG1umANfSqpAgkpoiwAHgr9xPXNbhC_Vnw_EQosvtpUAaxEPrRFk1_QACRx3rfP0cVgJM7Bg)
